thread:
mara (PM): planning note: need to pick a minimal visibility slice for next sprint that demonstrates value to customers quickly. candidates: cost-by-route panel, P95 latency + errors, lightweight trace hooks, and error-fingerprint search. which two should be highest priority?

leo (eng): prioritize trace hooks + cost panel. trace hooks unlock debugging flows; cost panel drives immediate ROI conversations.

anya (SRE): agree on those two. requirements: default sampling very low (0.01) and quota per-org; alerts on ingest spike >2x baseline for 10m. also retention: traces 3d for pilot.

trey (data): for cost panel I'll need route_name, model_id, tokens, infra_cost_usd fields. we can pre-aggregate daily to keep the dashboard snappy.

mara (PM): acceptance criteria proposal: 1) cost panel template + pilot org hooked up, 2) trace hooks with SDK + middleware and E2E perf <2% overhead at target load, 3) error search showing top 5 fingerprints in last 24h. rollout: canary 5% orgs, auto-throttle on ingestion spike. owners: leo -> traces, trey -> cost panel, anya -> guardrails.

leo (eng): timeline: spike for SDK by Wed, PR for middleware by Fri. I'll add per-route opt-in flags.

anya (SRE): I'll draft runbook and create alerts in prod sandbox.

mara (PM): great. I'll assemble pilot list and comms. please react :thumbsup: to own tasks. vis-bot: created epic VIS-mini-surface (https://redwood.internal/epics/VIS-mini-surface).
